\[1 = 50 - 7 \cdot 7.\]
This shows that the inverse of 7 modulo 50 is \(-7\), which is equivalent to \(43\) modulo 50 (since \(-7 + 50 = 43\)). Therefore, the inverse of 7 modulo 50 is 43.
